newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S&P assigns K-1 to Landshypotek Skr programme.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns K-1 to Landshypotek Skr programme.

text.p: U.S. credit ratings agency Standard & Poor's said on Wednesday it assigned a K-1 rating to mortgage lender Landshypotek's five billion crown domestic commercial paper programme.

S&P has already assigned its single A- long-term counterparty rating and A-2 short-term counterparty rating to Landshypotek, the largest provider of mortgage finance to the agriculture sector in Sweden, with assets totalling 28.7 billion crowns at end 1996.
The outlook is stable, S&P added. -- Simon Haydon, Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700-1004
